reason: B is the stronger proposal because layerwise remelting is a specific, non-trivial extension with a quantitative falsification threshold and directly targets lack-of-fusion defects, although its residual-stress and microstructure claims require validation because added heat can also worsen distortion or coarsening. A is physically plausible but largely restates the already-cited standard preheating approach and gives neither an alloy-specific rationale for 500 °C nor a quantitative predicted improvement.
